shadowSentences: I enjoy reading in my free time.
Traveling helps me learn about new cultures.
Cooking meals at home can be very rewarding.
Listening to music makes my day better.
Taking walks improves my mood and health.
I often volunteer at local community events.
Gardening is a peaceful way to spend time outdoors.
Learning new languages opens up many opportunities.
Spending time with family is important to me.
I believe that exercise is essential for a balanced life.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your most memorable travel experience?
Q2: What challenges did you face while traveling?
Q3: How do you feel about the impact of travel on personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about the influence of music.
questions: Q1: What role has music played in your life?
Q2: Have you ever faced any difficulties in learning an instrument?
Q3: In your opinion, how does music affect our emotions?
Q4: What tips would you suggest for someone starting to learn an instrument?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about the importance of sports.
questions: Q1: What sports do you enjoy playing or watching?
